_readme: Vendors we know and like around Rochester, NY. Drives /vendors.html.
EMPTY UNTIL THE OWNER FILLS IT IN, and it must stay that way. Every entry names a
real business. Inventing one, or guessing a handle from a name, publishes a
recommendation that could send somebody to the wrong seller or to nobody at
all. The page renders an honest empty state rather than placeholder rows.
A vendor is somebody who SELLS, usually at the shows on /card-shows.html.
That is the difference from data/shops.json, which is bricks-and-mortar
stores with an address and opening hours. A vendor may have neither.
Add one with a name. Everything else is optional and simply does not render
when missing: blurb, url, links, shows, sells, area, and any handle in
shared/socials.mjs -- youtube, instagram, tiktok, twitch, facebook, discord,
x, whatnot, ebay. THAT FILE IS THE AUTHORITY, not this list: an earlier
version of this line named only six of them, and `links`, `youtube` and
`discord` are all read and rendered while going unmentioned here. RocPokeCon
reaches its audience through `links` alone, so a maintainer tidying away a
field this readme did not vouch for would have deleted their only address.
SOCIAL HANDLES GO IN WITHOUT THE @, and as the handle only, never a full url
with tracking on it. The builder makes the link.
`vouched` marks a vendor the owner has actually bought from. Only set it where that
is true: the whole value of a local list is that it is not a directory.

`name` IS A FOREIGN KEY. data/shows.json joins confirmed vendors to this file on name, so it must be unique here (the build throws on a duplicate) and renaming a vendor breaks every show that names them until those are updated. A `logo` requires `logoW`/`logoH` and its built renditions under public/assets/creators/, or the build fails: a logo goes up only where its owner sent it for this use, and the show card is a second use of that same permission.

THE ARRAY ORDER IS THE PAGE ORDER. build-locals.mjs renders this list as it stands and sorts it by nothing, so appending a vendor puts them last and reordering here is how the page is reordered. The owner set this order on 3 September 2026: TOAK Pulls, Legends Card Shop, RocPokeCon. Pok.eJoe Trading Cards was appended on 4 September 2026 and Skull & Bones Collectibles on 8 September 2026, which is what appending is supposed to do. ON 8 SEPTEMBER 2026 HE MOVED RocPokeCon TO LAST -- "make roc pokemon the last vendor on this page" -- so the order is now TOAK Pulls, Legends Card Shop, Pok.eJoe, Skull & Bones, RocPokeCon. The rule is still that the order here IS the page, and that it is his to set: do not re-sort this list by name, by date added, or by how many shows a vendor is confirmed at.

vendors.name: TOAK Pulls
vendors.area: Rochester, NY and the wider region
vendors.sells: Sealed, singles and graded slabs, in person at shows
vendors.vouchedNote: The owner, 27 August 2026: "i do buy from TOAK Pulls, i always buy Japanese booster packs from them at every local show I see them at" and "they are legit and fair vendors love working with them". Ten rips on this site open packs credited to them in their own descriptions.
vendors.blurb: At all the local shows around the region, and they travel out of state for the bigger ones too. Japanese boosters are what I buy from them, at every local show I catch them at. Legit, fair, and good to deal with.
vendors.shows: Local shows around Rochester, NY, plus out of state
vendors.logoNote: Sent by them for this use, August 27, 2026.

vendors.name: Legends Card Shop
vendors.area: Rochester, NY, and out to Buffalo and Syracuse
vendors.sells: Modern and vintage singles, slabs, plushies and pins, in person at shows
vendors.blurb: A father and son who started vending in the summer of 2023 and have built a name for fair deals and quality cards. What they bring depends on the show: modern and vintage singles, slabs, plushies and pins. Rochester, NY, Buffalo and Syracuse are the staple spots, and they have traveled as far as Connecticut, Wisconsin and Las Vegas. They buy, sell and trade Pokemon, and are moving into Naruto and Dragon Ball.
vendors.blurbNote: Their own words, sent to the channel 3 September 2026, tightened and moved to third person to match the other rows. Nothing was added: the claims, the cities and the 2023 start are all theirs. Two fixes only -- "graded guards" is a typo for cards and was already covered by "slabs", and "Dragonball tcg" is Dragon Ball. NOT a vouch: the owner has not said he buys from them, and `vouched` on this file means he has.
vendors.shows: Rochester, NY, Buffalo and Syracuse, plus out of state
vendors.logoNote: Sent by them for this use, 3 September 2026. The first version of this row used a crop of a message screenshot; they sent the clean file the same evening and this is that file, untouched.
vendors.flyerNote: Their upcoming show dates, sent 3 September 2026. The image they sent is cut off below the last row, mid-sentence at "COME SEE US &", so anything under that is not on this site.

vendors.name: Pok.eJoe Trading Cards
vendors.sells: Raw singles vintage, mid era and modern, plus PSA graded slabs
vendors.blurb: Raw singles across all three eras, vintage, mid era and modern, and every slab they bring is PSA graded. A Rochester, NY vendor working the local show circuit.
vendors.blurbNote: Built from the owner's own words, 4 September 2026: "pok.ejoe trading cards - Rochester, NY Vendor Selling raw singles vintage, mid era & modern. All PSA graded slabs." Nothing added. NOT a vouch: he has not said he buys from them, and `vouched` on this file means he has.
vendors.logoNote: Sent by the owner for this use, 4 September 2026.
vendors.nameNote: The logo sets the name in caps as POK.EJOE over POKEMON CARDS and he wrote it "pok.ejoe trading cards", so the mid-word capital is a reading of the wordmark rather than something either source states. `name` is a foreign key that data/shows.json joins on, so changing it means changing every show that names them.

vendors.name: Skull & Bones Collectibles
vendors.sells: Buy, sell and trade, in person at shows
vendors.blurb: Local to Rochester, NY, and out on the show circuit most weekends: their own September list runs Arch Angel and the Extreme Pokemon show in Batavia, then out to the Mill Creek Mall in Erie for a three day one. They buy, sell and trade at the table.
vendors.shows: Local shows around Rochester, NY, plus out of state
vendors.logoNote: Sent by them for this use, 8 September 2026, with their upcoming-shows flyer.
vendors.areaNote: The owner, 8 September 2026: "just confirmed that Skull & Bones Collectibles is a local Rochester, NY vendor". This read "Rochester, NY and the wider region, plus Erie, PA" for one build, which was assembled from their own shows flyer and described their TRAVEL rather than where they are from -- a vendor who turns up at Rochester, NY shows and one who is based here are different claims, and the flyer could only support the first. He confirmed the second. The Erie, PA trip is still on the record, in `shows` and in the blurb, where it belongs: it is where they go, not where they are.
vendors.whatnotNote:
THE WHATNOT LINK CAME OFF AND THE CLAIM THAT THEY STREAM CAME WITH IT. The owner, 8 September 2026: "Skull & Bones Collectibles actually doesn't stream live on what not ... they have a what not page that they sell random stuff on but not part of their main business." This entry had "live on Whatnot" in `sells` and "they stream on Whatnot between shows" in the blurb, both of which were mine: I resolved the handle out of a share link he passed on and read a channel to buy from them into an account that is not one.
The account exists and is skullnbonescollectibles. It is not stored as a `whatnot` handle, because on this page a link under a vendor's name reads as "here is where to buy from them", and this file's own rule is that the value of a local list is that it is NOT a directory. Pointing a reader at a page the vendor does not sell cards on is the same kind of wrong as a stale price. Put it back the moment they say it is a real sales channel.
Their business is the table at the shows, and the card says that and nothing more.

vendors.name: Jake's Place
vendors.area: Batavia, NY, and out to Pittsburgh and Ohio
vendors.sells: Pokemon, One Piece, Magic, Lorcana, video games, plush and more
vendors.blurb: Jake is a lifelong collector of all things nerdy who has been vending for over a year: Pokemon, One Piece, Magic, Lorcana, video games, plush and more. Batavia, NY based, and he travels for it -- he has been as far as Pittsburgh and Ohio recently.
vendors.shows: Local shows around Rochester, NY, plus out of state
vendors.logoNote: Sent by them for this use, 8 September 2026.

vendors.name: RocPokéCon
vendors.sells: Vendors at their own show and at other local ones
vendors.blurb: They run the biggest Pokemon card show in Rochester, NY, and they vend at it and at other shows around the area. From October 2026 they add a monthly one, the RocPokéTour: four big convention dates a year in an RIT arena with the rest at the RIT Inn, thirteen dates out to November 2027 and every one of them on the card shows page.
vendors.shows: RocPokéCon and the monthly RocPokéTour shows, plus other local ones
vendors.flyerNote: Their RocPokéTour save-the-dates, posted by @rocpokecon on Instagram and sent to the channel by the owner on 13 September 2026. THIS IS THE CLEAN COPY OF IT: the first one that arrived was a screenshot of the post with the platform's own like, comment and share controls burned over the artwork, and this one is the flyer itself, full bleed, with all fourteen rows legible. DATE AND VENUE ONLY IS ALL IT CARRIES -- it ends "More information coming soon!", so there are no times, no admission and no table counts on it, and none are published anywhere else either: rocpokecon.com was checked on 13 September and its home page still advertised June 13th 2026. December is not a missing row, it reads HAPPY HOLIDAYS instead of a venue.

vendors.name: ROC_TCG
vendors.area: Rochester, NY and Western New York
vendors.sells: Slabs, raw cards and sealed, in person at shows
vendors.blurb: A local Rochester, NY Pokemon vendor who travels the Western New York circuit. Buying, selling and trading slabs, raw cards and sealed. In their own words: come say hello, make some deals, and talk Pokemon.
vendors.shows: Shows around Rochester, NY, Batavia and Niagara Falls
vendors.logoNote: Sent by them for this use, relayed by the owner 22 September 2026.
vendors.sourceNote: THE BLURB IS THEIR OWN WORDS, lightly cut. They sent: "ROC_TCG is a local Rochester NY Pokemon card vendor that travels throughout the Western NY area. Come say hello, make some deals, and talk Pokemon with me!" and the line "Buy/Sell/Trade Slabs, Raw Cards, And Sealed", which is what `sells` carries. NOT VOUCHED, and that is not a judgement: `vouched` on this site means the OWNER has said outright that he buys from them, and he has not said it about this vendor. It is a fact about him, not about them, and it is left false until he says otherwise.
vendors.flyerNote: Their own upcoming-shows flyer, sent 22 September 2026. It is the source for all eight ROC_TCG rows in data/shows.json and for the two shows that flyer ADDED to the calendar: the Roc City Card Show on 4 October and the FRIDAY half of the 23-24 October Extreme Pokemon Show, which was on file as a Saturday only.
